comment: Cellular / SIM policy for the S10+ (beyond2lte). Read by tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-modem-diag.sh. The verdict chain follows the hardware: host_present -> cp_status -> firmware_candidate_verified -> cbd_available -> cp_boot_completed -> ipc_responsive -> rfs_responsive -> sim_ready -> registered -> bearer_connected -> rmnet_verified. On this device the first real blocker is cp_status: IOCTL_MODEM_STATUS reports OFFLINE. A missing Shannon ModemManager plugin is a LATER hop, never the first blocker. Never prints a signal, operator or registration value that was not read from a real API; never fakes a data connection; never writes to any partition (modem/EFS/SEC_EFS/calibration/IMEI are read-only if referenced at all); never touches a bootloader. Owner-authorized BOOT-only repair via TWRP is a separate, narrowly scoped recovery operation (see reports/S5000AP-01-LIVE-GATES.md); it does not weaken the modem/radio/EFS denylist below.

device.modem: Samsung Shannon LTE (integrated; Cat 20 LTE, no 5G)

modem_stack_truth.reason: The S5000AP CP is not booted. The kernel probe works and exposes /dev/umts_* + rmnet0..7, but IOCTL_MODEM_STATUS reports OFFLINE. That is the first blocker; rebuilding the CP boot path (cbd/firmware/RFS/SIPC radio backend) comes before any ModemManager plugin or generic Samsung AT route.
modem_stack_truth.ofono_suitability: not demonstrated for Shannon LTE; no supported AT command channel has been verified
modem_stack_truth.voLTE_posture: VoLTE/IMS is NOT implemented and NOT available; calls and SMS are NOT implemented and NOT available (CP OFFLINE blocks even SIM access). See docs/volte-carrier-strategy.md while remaining truthful.
modem_stack_truth.do_not_transplant: Pixel / Exynos 5500 / Qualcomm modem instructions must NOT be applied to this Samsung modem.

interfaces.comment: Candidate host interfaces are ENUMERATED with globs; presence of a node is evidence of a transport, NOT of a working modem.
interfaces.net_comment: A rmnet/wwan netdev is a *potential* data bearer, never a data connection. No data connection is ever reported as up unless it really is.

modemmanager.comment: The stack hop. Only an explicitly S5000AP/Shannon-specific backend can satisfy this gate. A generic libmm-plugin-samsung.so is not evidence that it can boot or control the native Shannon CP and must not advance the state machine.
modemmanager.suitability_note: Even with mmcli installed, without a Shannon-capable plugin ModemManager cannot probe or register this modem.

sim.comment: SIM presence is only reported from a REAL, PROVENANCED source: a state file written by an authenticated detection run inside state_file_max_age_s, or the SIM object of an actual ModemManager modem (matched by /Modem/<n> -> SIM/<n>, then `mmcli -i <n> state`). `mmcli -L` showing a modem is NOT a ready SIM. A missing/stale/malformed file reports `unknown`, never `absent` or `present`. Offline/VM runs report `unknown`. SIM PIN, IMSI and ICCID are never printed.

supported_ui.detected_absent: the UI must be able to say SIM detected / SIM absent
supported_ui.pin_request: only where the platform supports it — on this device it is NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_DEVICE (no host modem stack)
supported_ui.carrier_identity: only from a real modem API; otherwise reported as unavailable
supported_ui.signal: only from a real modem API
supported_ui.registration: only from a real modem API
supported_ui.apn_config: an APN template exists, but it cannot be applied without a registered bearer

redaction.comment: Redaction runs on every line the tool prints from a modem source and is unit-tested offline (`redact` subcommand).

sim.state_file_trust_note: Stale or mock state files are UNKNOWN. Path traversal, arbitrary RFS copy-in and unauthenticated writers are out of scope.

apn.comment: Templates only. Nothing here can be applied on this device today, and the tool says so instead of pretending.
apn.requires: a registered data bearer from a supported modem stack (none exists for Shannon LTE)

registration.comment: Truthful reporting contract: these fields may ONLY be filled from a live ModemManager query, and the tool never guesses.
registration.empty_means: unavailable (no supported modem stack), NOT 'no signal'

at_channel.comment: An AT channel is NOT opened by default. If the owner explicitly asks, only a read-only allowlist is permitted, every command is logged, and the output is redacted. Nothing runs at boot.
at_channel.forbidden_comment: Anything that could change radio state, unlock, write NV/EFS, or send a raw APDU is refused outright — EFS/IMEI/calibration are never touched.

protected_partitions.comment: Denylist copied from the mission invariants. No Nuxel tool WRITES or flashes these. Separately, the owner's TWRP agreement permits BOOT/OS repair only; that is a different, narrowly scoped operation and does NOT authorize any mod/efs/radio/radiobak/efs_... partition write.

radio.purpose: read-only CP firmware boot source (Stage-04), resolved via GPT PARTLABEL 'radio' = /dev/sda16 (52,428,800 B, EFUJ2). Bounded, approved, stream-only reads only; never a RADIO write.

protected_partitions.flashing_tools_forbidden_scope: modem/radio/efs/radiobak/cp_debug and all protected_partitions. NOT a blanket ban on owner-approved BOOT-only repair.
protected_partitions.boot_repair_allowed_only: TWRP adb readback+dd of the BOOT partition under the signed owner agreement, with preflight hashes and a known-good rollback. No DTBO, no modem, no radio, no efs.

diagnostics.claim_policy: never print signal/registration/operator that was not read from a real API; never claim data without a real bearer

cp_status.comment: Read with a single IOCTL_MODEM_STATUS _IO('o',0x27) on /dev/umts_boot0 opened O_RDONLY. Never inferred from rmnet DOWN, a plugin, a service state, a JSON fixture or an old report.

firmware.comment: Proprietary CP blobs stay outside this repository. Only a hash-verified owner receipt qualifies as firmware_candidate_verified.
firmware.must_not_use_reason: Boot journal shows samsung-abox 18c50000.abox loads calliope_sram*.bin; these are ABOX/audio DSP images, not the S5000AP cellular CP.

cbd.comment: cpboot_v3 with SIPC+legacy ioctl compatibility. Availability of an executable does NOT prove a completed CP boot.
